Maya: Heads-up  OrbitLogix converted their pilot to a 12-month Dedicated contract via NorthWave resell. Went live this morning  big win for Marketplace/Reseller channel! :tada:

Jon: Nice! ACV $330k, billing next month. Pilot stats looked solid. Who's owning the case study + resell announcement?

Priyanka: Marketing will own the case study and the resell blurb. @Maya can you share pilot metrics and a customer-approved quote? Also request logo permission and a short CTO clip.

Maya: Contact is Sofia Laurent, CTO  sofia@orbitlogix.com. Pilot highlights: 2.8x p95 latency reduction, cost per inference down ~39%, enabled an always-on routing feature. Draft quote: "Redwood Dedicated on NorthWave gave us predictable latency and cost so we could ship realtime routing."

Lee: Eng notes: deployed `redwood deploy --pool dedicated-eu-1 --region eu-west-1` with quantized-8 and per-customer KV caching. Sustained 140 QPS, p95 ~62ms for 300 tokens. Will upload perf graphs to the shared drive. Note: OrbitLogix applied a lightweight pre-tokenizer that reduced tokens by ~5%  we'll include a reproducibility note.

annie-legal: Need explicit logo + testimonial release. Also NorthWave wants a short co-marketing addendum to our reseller agreement. I'll draft and loop them in.

Priyanka: Timeline: draft case study by Thu, legal review Fri, customer sign-off early next week, publish with NorthWave resell listing ~10 business days post-signoff. I'll own the assets.

Jon: Sales to confirm PO and billing cadence; I'll follow up with Sofia.

marketplace-bot: Reseller listing "northwave-orbitlogix" draft uploaded at 2026-04-10T09:05:00Z  awaiting partner approval.

Maya: Thanks team  will post a company-wide shout after Legal and NorthWave approve the copy. :rocket:
